verdict.rationale: A live probe shows HMRC's developer hub serves a real robots.txt (HTTP 200) with explicit rules, so an agent can learn what it may fetch before fetching anything. Those rules are restrictive: "Disallow: /" for all agents, with an Allow only for Googlebot. The story is about the policy being published and machine-readable, not about it being permissive. Missing for 10: robots.txt evidence for the main gov.uk guidance host and the API host, and corroboration beyond a single probe of one subdomain.
